digest.component_or_area: ticket transition and force logic documentation
propositions: Public Python transition documentation incorrectly claims that force bypasses the unresolved-children close restriction, contradicting CLI and implementation behavior
The distinction between gates (which force bypasses) and ticket-system invariants (which force cannot bypass) is not clearly documented across all user-facing surfaces
Documentation hardcodes current gates rather than defining force behavior as a general abstraction that bypasses all gates including future ones
The open-children close prohibition must be reclassified as a ticket-system invariant rather than a gate to align semantics with remediation goals
Contract tests do not exist to verify that force bypasses enabled gates while respecting the open-children invariant
